title: NBA Prediction SOTA 2026: Calibration-Aware Stacked Ensemble + Uncertainty Quantification

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
sources.key_finding: LSTM with Monte Carlo dropout provides calibrated probabilities; Brier 0.221 with ECE minimization. Uncertainty estimates are crucial for principled Kelly sizing.
sources.relevance: HIGH — directly addresses calibration gap in our current fleet (CV→holdout negative gap ~-0.01)

sources.title: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction analysis
sources.key_finding: Stacked ensemble (NB + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + DT + LR meta-learner) achieves Brier 0.199. Logistic regression as meta-learner outperforms direct LR base.
sources.relevance: HIGH — stacking with LR meta-learner is actionable on CPU Spaces

sources.title: Integration of machine learning XGBoost and SHAP models for NBA game outcome prediction
sources.key_finding: XGBoost with SHAP feature selection achieves Brier 0.202. SHAP-based feature pruning to 50-80 features outperforms full feature set.
sources.relevance: MEDIUM — confirms our MAX_FEATURES=200 may be too high; 50-80 features per SHAP is optimal

sources.title: Machine Learning for Basketball Game Outcomes (MDPI 2026)
sources.key_finding: CNN achieves Brier 0.221; logistic regression baseline Brier 0.199; XGBoost Brier 0.202.
sources.relevance: MEDIUM — confirms LR as strong meta-learner; CNN not viable on CPU islands

actionable_techniques.description: Train base learners (XGBoost, LightGBM, ExtraTrees, RandomForest) on fold-k out-of-fold predictions. Train LogisticRegression meta-learner on stacked OOF predictions.
actionable_techniques.implementation: Add stacking layer to GA individual evaluation. Score stacked prediction instead of base model prediction.

actionable_techniques.technique: Expected Calibration Error (ECE) minimization via isotonic regression
actionable_techniques.description: Post-hoc calibration of raw model probabilities using isotonic regression (already attempted in Colab — achieved 0.22054). Port to island GA fitness function: add ECE as secondary Pareto objective.
actionable_techniques.implementation: Add ECE to NSGA-II Pareto objectives alongside Brier and ROI. Islands already use isotonic calibration option.

actionable_techniques.description: Literature confirms 50-80 SHAP-selected features outperform 200-feature sets. Our GA is already using MAX_FEATURES=200 cap and selecting 26-76f per champion. Explicitly seed new populations with SHAP-top-75f subsets.
actionable_techniques.implementation: Run SHAP on best S14 individual, extract top-75 features, inject as elite Gen-0 seeds on S13/S15 after next reset.

actionable_techniques.description: Current walkforward shows negative CV→holdout gap (-0.01) indicating window bias. Stratified monthly re-cut will give honest out-of-sample estimate. Already queued per CLAUDE.md.
actionable_techniques.implementation: Kaggle P100 job — already noted in CLAUDE.md as queued

cross_port_to_political.pol_specific_addition: Political domain benefits from calibration more than NBA (higher outcome uncertainty, longer event windows). ECE secondary objective recommended for P2 to break 0.25003 plateau.

summary: SOTA literature achieves Brier 0.199 with stacked LR meta-ensemble (Nature 2025). Our gap is 0.021 from fleet best 0.22019. Primary path: (1) stacked ensemble LR meta-learner on S14/S22, (2) ECE as NSGA-II Pareto objective on all islands, (3) SHAP top-75f elite seeding on S13. Combined expected gain: ~-0.006 Brier → projected 0.214, still above 0.20 target but significant progress. GPU burst (TabICL) remains the primary path to 0.20.
